findings.text: The specification promises unchanged derivations, but `build-support/tests.nix` includes the pytest plugin and shared observability modules in every suite's source inputs, so changing them invalidates cached results. Fix: permit invalidation from changed source files while prohibiting per-run provenance from entering derivation inputs.

The specification assumes cached executions were already imported, but direct `nix-build` does not import them, and ADR 0028 explicitly preserves recovery through cached results. Fix: reconcile the proposed exclusion with ADR 0028 and document any intentional loss of cached-observation recovery.

The specification identifies `@` as the code that ran, but `jj --ignore-working-copy` can return a stale commit that excludes local edits used by the tests. Fix: describe this value as the last recorded working-copy commit and state that it does not identify unsnapshotted test inputs.
